description: Convention-based directory watching. The Overseer and edit-watcher scan these at runtime to detect new/deleted files across all categories. Nothing is hardcoded.

directories.convention: Each subdir is a feature. Expected file types defined in SPEC_GRAPH.file_types.known.

on_new_dir.details: Add feature ID to GLOSSARY, manifest.json build.phases, and store.json features[<name>].files. Scaffold missing standard files.

on_new_file.details: Add to SPEC_GRAPH.file_types.discovered. Propose PRECEDENCE level and graph edges.

on_delete_dir.details: Remove from GLOSSARY, manifest.json build.phases, and store.json features[<name>].files. Check for orphan story references.

on_delete_file.details: Remove SPEC_GRAPH edges. Clear STALE markers referencing deleted file.

directories.convention: Each .md file is an agent definition with YAML frontmatter (name, description, tools, model).

on_new_file.details: Add to .claude/agents/.system/agent-system.md role list, and store.json features[<name>].files if it owns files.

on_delete_file.details: Remove from dispatch tables, store.json features[*].files ownership records, and manifest.json agent references.

directories.convention: Each .md file is a skill. Subdirs contain sub-skills for multi-mode skills (audit/, preflight/).

on_new_file.details: Verify YAML frontmatter present. Check for references in CLAUDE.md. Add to skill index if missing.

on_delete_file.details: Remove references from CLAUDE.md, other skills, and any scheduled triggers.

directories.convention: Each .js file is a hook script. Must be wired in .claude/settings.json to be active.

on_new_file.details: Check if script is referenced in settings.json. If not, warn: unwired hook detected.

on_delete_file.details: Remove from settings.json hooks array. Check for other hooks that depend on it.

directories.convention: Files matching lint-*.js are linters. Must be in package.json lint:docs script.

on_new_file.details: Add to package.json lint:docs script chain. Verify it exports a runnable check.

on_delete_file.details: Remove from package.json lint:docs. Check if other scripts depend on it.

directories.convention: Each .md file is an architecture specification. May define cross-cutting contracts.

on_new_file.details: Add to SPEC_GRAPH explicit edges if it references features or types. Add to AGENT_GUIDE read list.

on_delete_file.details: Remove from SPEC_GRAPH. Check for references in CLAUDE.md, AGENT_GUIDE, builder prompts.

directories.convention: Each subdir is a third-party integration. knowledge/ contains reference docs.

on_new_dir.details: Add to THIRD_PARTY.md. Create SPEC_GRAPH edges to features that use it.

on_delete_dir.details: Remove from THIRD_PARTY.md. Clean up SPEC_GRAPH edges.

directories.convention: Each numbered subdir (01/, 02/, etc.) is a run retrospective.

on_new_dir.details: Verify BUGS.md, HYGIENE.md, LEARNINGS.md, RETRO.md exist. Scaffold missing files.

directories.convention: System-level canonical documents. Highest authority for product definitions.

on_new_file.details: High authority — add to SPEC_GRAPH as a root node. Update CLAUDE.md Key Files if significant.

on_delete_file.details: Canonical deletions are high-impact. Require explicit confirmation even in dark mode.

directories.convention: Templates and rules for spec writing. Changes cascade to all feature specs.

on_new_file.details: Add as SPEC_GRAPH template edge to relevant feature file types.
Verify referenced in manifest.json. Update EXTENSION_SPEC.md if structural.
